prompt:
A hand-painted 2D game background of one long BARE WALL of a gallery room built to display things. Pale chalk-white plaster above a low oak dado rail, with a shallow moulded picture rail running horizontally near the ceiling, and a narrow strip of pale herringbone floorboards along the bottom. Bright, gallery-like and uncluttered: chalk white, warm cream, pale oak. The picture rail is completely bare and the wall is blank plaster from corner to corner.

STRICT FLAT-ON WALL VIEW, and this is the most important instruction: the camera stands CLOSE TO THE BACK WALL and square to it. The BACK WALL is flat, rectangular and exactly parallel to the picture plane, and it FILLS ROUGHLY 85 PERCENT OF THE FRAME from edge to edge. The floor appears only as a shallow horizontal strip across the bottom eighth of the image. The ceiling appears only as a shallow strip across the very top, or not at all. The LEFT and RIGHT side walls are visible only as narrow slivers at the extreme left and right edges, a few percent of the width each, converging very slightly and symmetrically. This is almost a straight architectural elevation of one wall, NOT a view down a room. There is very little floor and almost no side wall. The camera is at standing eye level, looking level and straight ahead, dead centre, with no tilt, no roll and no rotation.

THE ROOM MUST BE COMPLETELY BARE. There is NO fireplace, NO hearth, NO chimney breast, NO mantelpiece and NO fire anywhere in the image. There is no furniture of any kind: no table, no chairs, no bed, no chest, no shelves, no cabinets, no rug, no carpet, no barrels, no crates, no plinths, no display cases. NOTHING hangs on the walls: no pictures, no frames, no mounts, no trophies, no tools, no lamps, no candles, no plaques. Nothing stands on the floor. The back wall is UNBROKEN from corner to corner. This is an empty shell that things will be painted on top of later, so the whole wall must be clear and unoccupied.

Soft gouache and watercolour painting with warm brown ink linework, visible brush texture, gentle washes rather than hard cel shading. Storybook illustration style, calm and warm, not photographic and not 3D rendered. Even, soft, diffuse daylight with no dramatic shadows. No people, no animals, no text, no watermark, no signature, no border, no vignette, no frame.
